trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the proof of prop:dq-squared. Verified the whole computation by hand: d_q(d_q alpha) = a^2 d^2 alpha + ab d(Theta wedge L_xi alpha) + ab Theta wedge L_xi d alpha + b^2 Theta wedge L_xi(Theta wedge L_xi alpha) with a = q^{-1}, b = 1-q^{-1}; term 1 vanishes by d^2 = 0; term 2 expands as ab dTheta wedge L_xi alpha - ab Theta wedge d L_xi alpha since Theta is a 1-form; term 3 cancels its negative part by [d, L_xi] = 0; L_xi Theta = iota_xi dTheta + d(Theta(xi)) = 0 by Cartan, so term 4 becomes b^2 Theta wedge Theta wedge L_xi^2 alpha = 0. Result ab dTheta wedge L_xi alpha is correct. trap-negation-contrast.notes: MATH DEFECT REPORTED, NOT FIXED (math-adjacent, per skill: report never fix inline). The token '\\mathcal{L}_\\xid\\alpha' appears twice - once in the align block (third term) and once in the prose sentence about [d, L_xi] = 0. The intended reading is L_xi (d alpha), but '\\xid' is a REAL macro: main.tex:222 defines \\newcommand{\\xid}{{\\xi_{d}}} ('Reeb field (d-component)'). So the PDF silently typesets L_{xi_d} alpha instead of L_xi d alpha, turning the key cancellation sentence into 'Theta wedge L_{xi_d} alpha = Theta wedge d L_xi alpha', which is not what [d, L_xi] = 0 gives. On the KaTeX/markdown render path \\xid is not defined at all, so the same two spots error out. These are the only two occurrences of \\xid in all of content/. PROPOSED FIX: insert a space - '\\mathcal{L}_\\xi d\\alpha' in both places.
